gudhi.reason: GUDHI is load-bearing: AlphaComplex builds the point-cloud alpha filtration, create_simplex_tree materializes the alpha complex, and persistence reports the H1 birth/death verdicts.

square_alpha_has_one_finite_h1_bar.expected: one H1 interval born at side-edge alpha square 0.25 and killed at triangle alpha square 0.5
square_alpha_has_one_finite_h1_bar.admission_note: The square side edges create a 1-cycle at alpha square 0.25; a Delaunay diagonal and adjacent triangles enter at alpha square 0.5 and kill it.

square_alpha_materializes_killing_triang.expected: two 2-simplices exist at the H1 killing threshold

center_point_fills_square_excludes_h1_ba.expected: no positive-length H1 interval when the center point fills the square before the outer cycle survives
center_point_fills_square_excludes_h1_ba.exclusion_note: The center point connects to all corners at alpha square 0.125, so the square does not admit the same persistent outer H1 bar as the four-corner fixture.

centered_square_uses_center_edges_before.expected: center-corner edges enter at alpha square 0.125

side_alpha_boundary_has_edges_before_tri.expected: at alpha square 0.25 the square has only vertices and side edges
side_alpha_boundary_has_edges_before_tri.boundary_note: This cutoff fixture checks the edge-entry boundary and absence of triangles; the full square fixture checks the finite H1 death.

two_point_and_singleton_boundaries_repor.expected: two points merge at alpha square 0.25 and a singleton exposes no H1

surviving_alternatives: Other alpha-complex point-cloud fixtures may survive; this micro receipt only covers the named AlphaComplex persistence surface.
RipsComplex and manual SimplexTree persistence remain separate GUDHI surfaces and are not retested here.
next_lego_target: minimal AlphaComplex point-cloud fixture before topology coupling or graph-cell promotion

demotion_condition: Demote GUDHI for this AlphaComplex surface if it cannot build the tiny point-cloud simplex tree, if square H1 is not born at alpha square 0.25 and killed at alpha square 0.5, if the centered square reports a positive-length H1 bar, or if finite singleton/boundary filtrations cannot be reported.
